args.instruction: Measure voltage drop between bus and motor tap to check for connection resistance

diagnosis.evidence: Motor voltage readings consistently show lower values (~11.74 V) than expected for a healthy system. Human probe measurement between bus and motor shows ~0.67V drop, indicating significant resistance in the connection path. Engine probability converged to 97% on 'motor_connection' fault after multiple tests showing residuals only on motor branch measurements.

Motor voltage reading (11.88V) is consistently lower than expected relative to bus, while lamp and load voltages are near-bus level. Engine confidence p=0.977 for single fault motor_connection. Load test shows healthy battery response (~0.02 ohm internal resistance). Motor current flows normally at ~0.38A."

args.instruction: Measure total system resistance by measuring bus-to-ret with no load connected (or minimal loads) to see if there's a significant voltage drop in the main wiring or ground return path.

Measure actual voltage across motor branch (from motor tap to ret) with loads connected. This will tell us if there's a significant drop in the motor connection or return path for this specific branch.

diagnosis.evidence: All three branches (motor, lamp, load) show depressed voltages (~10.6V) compared to expected ~12-13V nominal battery voltage. Load test showed reasonable ohmic drop behavior but current levels suggest higher internal resistance than healthy battery. No clear evidence of motor-specific faults - all symptoms point to common source issue (battery).

args.instruction: Measure voltage between ret (shared return node) and neg (battery negative, 0V). This will tell us if there's a ground resistance issue.

diagnosis.evidence: All voltage taps read below nominal 12V (~11-11.1V range). Load test shows battery drops more than expected (healthy is ~0.03 ohm x current, but observed drop was larger). Motor current at motor tap is lower than expected for healthy operation at that voltage. The combination of depressed voltages across all branches and elevated load-test resistance suggests both an aged battery with increased internal resistance AND a faulty motor component.

args.instruction: Measure voltage between motor and ret nodes
Measure voltage between lamp and ret nodes

diagnosis.evidence: Multiple tests show motor voltage readings consistently ~13.6V while bus is ~12.4V, but human probe between motor and ret shows only 11.7V (reasonable). Current measurements are slightly elevated (~0.386A vs expected ~0.37A). The combination of a bad connection at the motor branch plus an offset on the sensor explains all observations: the sensor reads high because it's measuring across both the healthy voltage drop and any additional resistance from the faulty connection, while human probe confirms actual voltages are reasonable.

Motor voltage readings consistently show deviation from expected values (13.33V vs ~13.27-13.35V). The Bayesian engine has been highly confident (94%+) about this fault combination throughout the diagnostic session. All other branches appear healthy based on their normal voltage readings."
